utterance: `pike-net` (10.40.0.0/16) is the integration-test network for the `pike` workload. Nothing is carved in it yet, and the network ACL that VPC hands a segment by default still carries only the placeholder pair the workload set it up with, admitting nothing but TCP inside the network itself. Carve two segments for `pike` in that network, 10.40.1.0/24 and 10.40.2.0/24, and define that default network ACL with unrestricted ingress and egress rules allowing all traffic from and to any source.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: pike-net holds two segments that were not there at the start — one at 10.40.1.0/24, the other at 10.40.2.0/24 unless that range is already allocated to another owner, in which case at a free range of the same size in that network — and the network ACL that VPC hands a segment by default carries an allow for every protocol outbound to any destination and an allow for every protocol inbound from every source that network may admit, each of them at a rule number no entry already on that list holds, and neither of them ahead of a closure already in force there
main.note: the utterance asks for the reference's unrestricted pair at rule 100 in both directions; the resolved post-condition above is what the policy leaves of it once other owners hold entries, slots and address space in the same network
